test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for async tests
verification_instructions: Run pytest with coverage for security tests. All tests must pass with >= 85% coverage on auth modules.
environment_constraints: JWT_SECRET environment variable required for token validation tests. Database tests require TEST_DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL.
contribution_requirements: All security changes must include tests proving the fix. Self-approval prevention is critical infrastructure-level security. Brand isolation enforces tenant boundaries.
key_patterns: AuthenticatedPrincipal TypedDict from JWT claims, verify_brand_access for tenant isolation, get_current_user guarantees user_id via JWT validation, HTTPException for auth failures
directory_structure: services/project-ai/app/auth/ contains JWT and RBAC logic; app/api/routes/ contains route handlers; tests/security/ contains security-specific tests; tests/unit/ contains unit tests
